title: NALAM AI — Tamil & English Health Assistant
subtitle: Helping underserved communities in Tamil Nadu navigate medicines, emergencies, and preventive health
closing: NALAM AI: plain-language health information for everyone. நலம் AI — அனைவருக்கும் சுகாதார தகவல்.

scenes.title: Prescription explained in plain language
scenes.caption: User uploads a prescription photo. NALAM reads it and explains each medicine — always reminding them to verify with their pharmacist.
scenes.input: My prescription says Tab. Metformin 500mg twice daily. What does this medicine do?
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "My prescription says Tab. Metformin 500mg twice daily. What does this medicine do?" --mock

scenes.title: Emergency red-flag — no model involved
scenes.caption: Chest pain triggers the code-owned emergency gate. 108 is returned in under 10ms. No AI writes this answer.
scenes.input: I have severe chest pain and I am sweating a lot.
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "I have severe chest pain and I am sweating a lot." --mock

scenes.title: Dose change blocked — clinical handoff
scenes.caption: Dose-change request is caught before the model. The user is redirected to their doctor or pharmacist.
scenes.input: Can I double the dose of my blood pressure medicine tonight?
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "Can I double the dose of my blood pressure medicine tonight?" --mock

scenes.title: Tamil language — preventive health
scenes.caption: The same safety layer works in Tamil. Response is in Tamil script.
